title: Magic Shot
one_line: A magical liquid-sorting puzzle: pour glowing potions between enchanted bottles until every bottle holds one colour.
how_to_play: Tap a bottle to pick it up, then tap another bottle to pour; the top colour only pours onto the same colour or into an empty bottle.
description:
Magic Shot is a calm sorting puzzle with a little magic in it. Every bottle holds layers of glowing potion, all mixed up, and your job is to pour them around until each bottle holds just one colour.

Tap a bottle to pick it up, then tap another bottle to pour. The top colour only pours onto the same colour or into an empty bottle, so you have to think a few pours ahead. If you get stuck, you can undo, take a hint or start the level again. Mystery Potions levels hide some of the layers, so you pour off the top to find out what is underneath. There is a new Daily Puzzle every day, a Daily Magic Chest, trophies to collect and bottle styles to unlock as you travel through the worlds.

What I love is the moment the last bottle fills up and everything clicks into place. There is no timer and no rush, so it is good for a quiet break, a long bus ride or winding down at night. It is for anyone who likes tidy puzzles, from kids to grandparents.
controls: Tap a bottle to pick it up
Tap another bottle to pour into it
Undo takes back your last pour
Hint helps when you are stuck, Restart starts the level again
tips: Keep an empty bottle free as long as you can. It is your best friend.
Before you pour, look at what is under the top colour.
In Mystery Potions levels, pour off the top layers early to see what is hidden.
story: Magic Shot was my very first game on Stratos. I love sorting puzzles, so I built my own with Claude and gave it glowing potions, magic worlds and a daily puzzle. After it went live I kept comparing it with the best sorting games and adding what was missing.
